evidence.observation: Full Sakai city map with the player marker in the southwest urban blocks; adjacent uniform samples are the immediately preceding interior/alley and following street route.
Second full Sakai city map view in the following episode with the player marker again in the southwest urban blocks; street footage appears immediately before and after.

acceptedCorrespondenceCandidates.whyNotGeometry: The cross-episode map occurrence is repeatable, but 10.6-14.2 second uniform spacing is too coarse to register the exact doorway or street segment to the map marker.

evidence.observation: Continuous route through narrow houses, a drainage canal, covered market frontage, white storehouse-like facades and waterfront-facing streets.

acceptedCorrespondenceCandidates.whyNotGeometry: Multiple route views are present, but no dense transition currently binds individual facades to a stable source-map point.

evidence.observation: Repeated city-map views lead into the west port, long pier, large ship, ship deck, return dock and waterfront buildings.
Elevated harbor panorama shows the ship, enclosed water basin, opposing shoreline blocks and multiple piers in one view.

acceptedCorrespondenceCandidates.whyNotGeometry: The harbor relationship is visually strong, but source-map marker pixels and the elevated panorama still need dense temporal binding and Atlas-coordinate registration.

rejectedClaims: No building footprint is accepted from visual similarity alone.
No source-map roads, shorelines or official geometry are extracted or traced.
The low-resolution uniform frames do not justify facade dimensions, roof heights or precise street widths.
P06 correspondence groups are not assumed to match the Yuyi structures until a direct feature-level cross-check exists.
